spec.scene: A soft patch of green backyard lawn bathed in warm golden light. At the center, a gentle cream-colored small dog rests peacefully curled on a pale quilted blanket. Behind her rises a leafy lemon tree dotted with ripe yellow fruit, casting dappled afternoon shadows across the grass. Two fallen lemons rest in the front right corner. At the back edge, a weathered wooden garden fence frames the peaceful scene in quiet warmth.
spec.title: Under the Lemon Tree
spec.caption: We sat together in her favorite sunny spot in the yard.
